title: A data sheet for the simultaneous assessment of dual radioactive tracer uptake in the heart
author: Kato

steps.title: Determine total radioisotope activity
steps.instruction: Measure the total activity of the 18FDG and the 125I‑labeled fatty‑acid tracer that will be used in the experiment.

steps.title: Prepare injection mixture
steps.instruction: Mix the measured 18FDG and 125I‑labeled fatty‑acid tracer with sterile saline to obtain a final injection volume calculated as (100–200 μL × number of rats) + 5 μL; the prepared volume must be greater than this calculated amount. The mixture should contain 500 μCi–1 mCi of 18FDG and 10–20 μCi of 125I tracer. For mice, adjust the volume to 20–50 μL per mouse.

steps.title: Record preparation details
steps.instruction: Enter the date, measured doses, measured times, numbers of animals, and the start‑time of the experiment into the data‑sheet (supplemental material) to enable automatic calculation of radioisotope activity at the experiment start.

steps.title: Assess animal baseline parameters
steps.instruction: Before any injection, assess each animal’s body weight and cardiac function, and measure blood glucose with a self‑monitoring blood glucose kit to verify that glucose levels will not confound 18FDG uptake.

steps.title: Insert tail‑vein catheter and inject tracers
steps.instruction: In overnight‑fasted rats, insert a 24‑gauge plastic needle attached to a thin saline‑filled tube into the tail vein. Inject a 100–200 μL volume (or 20–50 μL per mouse) that contains 1 mCi of 18FDG and 20 μCi of 125I‑labeled fatty‑acid tracer simultaneously, then flush the tube with additional saline.

substeps.instruction: Insert 24‑gauge needle with saline‑filled tube into tail vein of fasted rat.
Inject the calculated volume (100–200 μL per rat) containing 1 mCi 18FDG and 20 μCi 125I tracer.
Flush the catheter with saline to clear residual tracer.

steps.title: Wait and euthanize animals
steps.instruction: Allow the tracers to circulate for 45 minutes after injection, then euthanize each animal by decapitation or deep sedation and immediately place the excised heart in cold saline.

steps.title: Harvest and weigh hearts
steps.instruction: Collect blood, quickly rinse each heart in cold saline, and record the weight of each heart.

substeps.instruction: Wash heart briefly in cold saline.
Weigh the heart and record its mass.

steps.title: Process heart tissue for radioactivity measurement
steps.instruction: Embed the mid‑ventricle portion of each heart in methylcellulose and freeze on dry ice. Then excise and weigh one‑third of the apical side, freeze this piece in liquid nitrogen, and later measure its radioisotopic activity with a scintillation counter.

substeps.instruction: Embed mid‑ventricle specimen in methylcellulose and freeze on dry ice.
Collect and weigh a one‑third portion of the apical side.
Freeze the apical piece in liquid nitrogen for subsequent scintillation counting.
